objective.text: The primary objectives include obtaining soot-inception limits of quasi-steady normal and inverse spherical diffusion flames.
objective.quote: Obtain soot-inception limits of quasi-steady normal and inverse spherical diffusion flames as functions of flow rate, Zst, amount of inert (N2 or CO2), and pressure for C2H4 and CH4 flames.

fuel.text: The fuels tested are C2H4 and CH4.

sample_geometry.text: The experiment investigates spherical diffusion flames.
sample_geometry.quote: Perform spherical diffusion flame tests in drop towers and aboard the International Space Station.

variables.text: Variables include reactant dilutions, flow rates, and pressures.
variables.quote: Consider a broad range of reactant dilutions, flow rates and pressures for normal and inverse convection directions.

measurements.text: Flames are observed using cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples.
measurements.quote: Observe the flames with a broad suite of cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples.

safety_finding.text: Microgravity spherical diffusion flames extinguish when the peak temperature first decreases below 1130 K.
safety_finding.quote: Microgravity spherical diffusion flames extinguish when the peak temperature first decreases below 1130 K.

earth_benefits.text: The project has the potential for improving efficiency and reducing pollutant emissions in terrestrial combustors.
earth_benefits.quote: This project has the potential for improving efficiency and reducing pollutant emissions in terrestrial combustors.
